class.name: SteamMessagePeer
class.brief_description: Exact scoped permission to exchange Steam Messages.

method.name: send
method.description: Queues one packet of 1 to 4096 bytes on an allowed app channel. Defaults to reliable ordered delivery. [constant OK] confirms local queue acceptance. Pending binding proof can queue up to eight reliable frames and 16 KiB. A remote binding change drops queued packets from the previous binding. Unreliable sends return [constant ERR_BUSY] until the exact binding is proven. An unconfigured channel returns [constant ERR_UNAUTHORIZED].

method.name: close
method.description: Retires this exact local authorization and closes its framework-owned native channel. Native channels owned by other SDK consumers are preserved.

signal.name: received
signal.description: Emitted after copying and releasing the exact SDK packet. The app channel, identity, current scope, sequence, and size have been checked.

signal.name: closed
signal.description: Emitted once when local authorization is withdrawn, its Game generation retires, its pending proof expires, or an exact send reports a connection failure.
